name: Zutto Mae Kara Joshi Deshita
original_name: ずっと前から女子でした
source:
Haruya’s family runs a group of ryokan and he grew surrounded by women, led by his pushy sisters. He never truly got over his uneasiness around girls, so he had only attended boys’ schools until now. While he was more comfortable around his guy friends, he was at the age where he started to show interest in the opposite sex. He wondered if he could find a girl who was cute and not scary.

Returning to his hometown after ten years, he transferred to a co-ed school for the first time. He was excited to meet new people, but unexpectedly he was reacquainted with an old friend with whom he often played as kids.

“Eh… You weren’t a boy!?”

Haruya had always thought that Sena was a boy, so he was undoubtedly surprised when he discovered the truth. She had a totally different feel around her, and she had grown to become very beautiful….

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/10/17/october-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
晴也的家族经营着一系列日式旅馆，他在强势姐姐们的带领下，被女性包围着长大。他从未真正克服面对女孩时的不自在，因此至今只在男子学校就读。虽然和男性朋友相处更轻松，但他已经到了开始对异性感兴趣的年纪。他想找一个可爱又不可怕的女孩。

离开故乡十年后，他回到家乡，第一次转入男女同校的学校。正当他期待认识新朋友时，却意外与童年时期经常一起玩的老朋友重逢。

“诶……你不是男孩吗！？”

晴也一直以为濑奈是男孩，发现真相时自然大吃一惊。她给人的感觉完全不同了，也已经出落得十分美丽……
